youtube.title: UNDER THE HOOD
youtube.summary: Graham “Hoody” Hood reflects on recent health scares that revealed serious heart blockages in both himself and his wife Michelle, prompting them to reassess the stress and pace of their lives. He explores the pressures of modern life, the wisdom of the Serenity Prayer, and how accepting hardship, building character and focusing on what we can change can help us navigate stressful times. With Hoody and Michelle about to embark on their month-long Hoodie-on-a-Roady tour of New Zealand , he also looks ahead to the journey and the themes of faith, courage, truth and community that will shape their time on the road. Fore more Discover more from Hoody at Club Grubbery or find him on Facebook and X

Is this where the real long-term value of the FTA sits? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/john-ballingall-trade-economist-india-fta-a-long-term-play-for-nz #RCRMedia

How much harder does that make it for parents to know what their children are actually receiving? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/apostate-ari-the-transphobic-historian-the-cult-of-gender-one-detransitioners-journey-to-faith #RCRMedia

youtube.title: Maybe having the courage of your convictions would simply end with a smack on the kisser...
youtube.summary: 🌐 https://RCR.Media | "Maybe having the courage of your convictions would simply end with a smack on the kisser. And that prospect alone has always served as a great moderating factor in human interactions." - Rachel Stewart Whether it's fired off on social media, printed in a newspaper column, or thrown across Parliament, Stewart reckons people might choose their words a little more carefully if they actually had to say them face-to-face. Would public debate improve overnight if everyone had to ask themselves one question first: "Is this worth a smack on the kisser?" 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/riding-shotgun-with-rachel-stewart-more-packers-or-more-pughs #RCRMedia #RidingShotgun

Is that a fair rebalance, or too big a transfer of private wealth? 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/rob-macculloch-economics-professor-former-reserve-bank-adviser-tops-tax-reset-doesnt-add-up #RCRMedia
